name: package-manager
description: Holds Claude to the project's package manager and wrapper, giving the exact command to run instead, and stops it weakening the supply-chain guards of pnpm, npm, yarn, bun and uv: release-age gates, install scripts and overrides, plus hand-edited lockfiles. Global installs ask you first, with an option to choose the manager for them.

fallback.title: Without a lockfile
fallback.description: Managers to hold to when a project names none, one per ecosystem, comma-separated, like `pnpm, uv`. Empty holds to nothing.

globalManager.title: Global installs
globalManager.description: The manager Claude must use for global installs, one per ecosystem, comma-separated, like `pnpm, uv`; `pipx` for Python tools works too. A global install with another manager is stopped with the command to run instead. Every global install still asks you first. Empty sets none.
